item.text: The design will use a quiet ledger feel: warm white surfaces, ink-dark numbers, and a crisp orange accent. The main view will make outstanding and overdue totals easy to scan, with searchable invoices and a simple creation dialog.

from pathlib import Path

s=s.replace('color:#777d87','color:#6e7480').replace('color:#838894','color:#6b717c').replace('color:#969ba5','color:#7d838f')

# Keep touch controls comfortable without adding density to mouse layouts.
s=s.replace('@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)', '@media(pointer:coarse){.tab,.btn,.text-button{min-height:44px}.icon-button,.close,.row-more{width:44px;height:44px}}\\n@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)')
p.write_text(s)

python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.refs=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='use' and a.get('href','').startswith('#'):self.refs.append(a['href'][1:])
  if 'for' in a:self.refs.append(a['for'])
p=Check();p.feed(Path('index.html').read_text())
assert not [k for k,v in Counter(p.ids).items() if v>1], 'Duplicate IDs'
assert not set(p.refs)-set(p.ids), 'Missing references'
print('HTML references and unique IDs verified.')
PY
